'''menace64 The Best Hunt Down And Destory the Jedi Deck!!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[menace64]]
* '''Published:''' 6 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HD menace64 DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]
